resources.string: Change your videos' container without re-encoding them.
Searching for videos in the whole folder…
Local and offline remuxing: keeps quality and compatible tracks. It analyzes each file, warns about tracks that must be omitted, and verifies the output before publishing it.

Remux Folder uses MIT. FFmpegKit Maintained uses LGPL-3.0; AndroidX and Compose use Apache-2.0. No GPL variant is included. The app has no Internet permission and does not send your videos to any service.
